verses.ar: لُقْمَةٌ يَابِسَةٌ وَمَعَهَا سَلَامَةٌ، خَيْرٌ مِنْ بَيْتٍ مَلآنٍ ذَبَائِحَ مَعَ خِصَامٍ.
verses.kjv: Better [is] a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices [with] strife.
verses.web: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

verses.ar: اَلْعَبْدُ ٱلْفَطِنُ يَتَسَلَّطُ عَلَى ٱلِٱبْنِ ٱلْمُخْزِي وَيُقَاسِمُ ٱلْإِخْوَةَ ٱلْمِيرَاثَ.
verses.kjv: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causeth shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.web: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

verses.ar: ٱلْبُوطَةُ لِلْفِضَّةِ، وَٱلْكُورُ لِلذَّهَبِ، وَمُمْتَحِنُ ٱلْقُلُوبِ ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: The fining pot [is] for silver, and the furnace for gold: but the LORD trieth the hearts.
verses.web: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but Yahweh tests the hearts.

verses.ar: ٱلْفَاعِلُ ٱلشَّرَّ يَصْغَى إِلَى شَفَةِ ٱلْإِثْمِ، وَٱلْكَاذِبُ يَأْذَنُ لِلِسَانِ فَسَادٍ.
verses.kjv: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; [and] a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
verses.web: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

verses.ar: ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِئُ بِٱلْفَقِيرِ يُعَيِّرُ خَالِقَهُ. ٱلْفَرْحَانُ بِبَلِيَّةٍ لَا يَتَبَرَّأُ.
verses.kjv: Whoso mocketh the poor reproacheth his Maker: [and] he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
verses.web: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

verses.ar: تَاجُ ٱلشُّيُوخِ بَنُو ٱلْبَنِينَ، وَفَخْرُ ٱلْبَنِينَ آبَاؤُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Children’s children [are] the crown of old men; and the glory of children [are] their fathers.
verses.web: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.

verses.ar: لَا تَلِيقُ بِٱلْأَحْمَقِ شَفَةُ ٱلسُّودَدِ. كَمْ بِٱلْأَحْرَى شَفَةُ ٱلْكَذِبِ بِٱلشَّرِيفِ!
verses.kjv: Excellent speech becometh not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
verses.web: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

verses.ar: ٱلْهَدِيَّةُ حَجَرٌ كَرِيمٌ فِي عَيْنَيْ قَابِلِهَا، حَيْثُمَا تَتَوَجَّهْ تُفْلِحْ.
verses.kjv: A gift [is as] a precious stone in the eyes of him that hath it: whithersoever it turneth, it prospereth.
verses.web: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَسْتُرْ مَعْصِيَةً يَطْلُبِ ٱلْمَحَبَّةَ، وَمَنْ يُكَرِّرْ أَمْرًا يُفَرِّقْ بَيْنَ ٱلْأَصْدِقَاءِ.
verses.kjv: He that covereth a transgression seeketh love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth [very] friends.
verses.web: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

verses.ar: اَلِٱنْتِهَارُ يُؤَثِّرُ فِي ٱلْحَكِيمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ مِئَةِ جَلْدَةٍ فِي ٱلْجَاهِلِ.
verses.kjv: A reproof entereth more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
verses.web: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

verses.ar: اَلشِّرِّيرُ إِنَّمَا يَطْلُبُ ٱلتَّمَرُّدَ فَيُطْلَقُ عَلَيْهِ رَسُولٌ قَاسٍ.
verses.kjv: An evil [man] seeketh only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.web: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

verses.ar: لِيُصَادِفِ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ دُبَّةٌ ثَكُولٌ وَلَا جَاهِلٌ فِي حَمَاقَتِهِ.
verses.kjv: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.web: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

verses.ar: مَنْ يُجَازِي عَنْ خَيْرٍ بِشَرٍّ لَنْ يَبْرَحَ ٱلشَّرُّ مِنْ بَيْتِهِ.
verses.kjv: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.web: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

verses.ar: اِبْتِدَاءُ ٱلْخِصَامِ إِطْلَاقُ ٱلْمَاءِ، فَقَبْلَ أَنْ تَدْفُقَ ٱلْمُخَاصَمَةُ ٱتْرُكْهَا.
verses.kjv: The beginning of strife [is as] when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
verses.web: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

verses.ar: مُبَرِّئُ ٱلْمُذْنِبَ وَمُذَنِّبُ ٱلْبَرِيءَ كِلَاهُمَا مَكْرَهَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: He that justifieth the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both [are] abomination to the LORD.
verses.web: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.

verses.ar: لِمَاذَا فِي يَدِ ٱلْجَاهِلِ ثَمَنٌ؟ أَلِٱقْتِنَاءِ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلَيْسَ لَهُ فَهْمٌ؟
verses.kjv: Wherefore [is there] a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing [he hath] no heart [to it]?
verses.web: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

verses.ar: اَلصَّدِيقُ يُحِبُّ فِي كُلِّ وَقْتٍ، أَمَّا ٱلْأَخُ فَلِلشِّدَّةِ يُولَدُ.
verses.kjv: A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.web: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

verses.ar: اَلْإِنْسَانُ ٱلنَّاقِصُ ٱلْفَهْمِ يَصْفِقُ كَفًّا وَيَضْمَنُ صَاحِبَهُ ضَمَانًا.
verses.kjv: A man void of understanding striketh hands, [and] becometh surety in the presence of his friend.
verses.web: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

verses.ar: مُحِبُّ ٱلْمَعْصِيَةِ مُحِبُّ ٱلْخِصَامِ. ٱلْمُعَلِّي بَابَهُ يَطْلُبُ ٱلْكَسْرَ.
verses.kjv: He loveth transgression that loveth strife: [and] he that exalteth his gate seeketh destruction.
verses.web: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

verses.ar: ٱلْمُلْتَوِي ٱلْقَلْبِ لَا يَجِدُ خَيْرًا، وَٱلْمُتَقَلِّبُ ٱللِّسَانِ يَقَعُ فِي ٱلسُّوءِ.
verses.kjv: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
verses.web: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَلِدُ جَاهِلًا فَلِحَزَنِهِ، وَلَا يَفْرَحُ أَبُو ٱلْأَحْمَقِ.
verses.kjv: He that begetteth a fool [doeth it] to his sorrow: and the father of a fool hath no joy.
verses.web: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.

verses.ar: ٱلْقَلْبُ ٱلْفَرْحَانُ يُطَيِّبُ ٱلْجِسْمَ، وَٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْمُنْسَحِقَةُ تُجَفِّفُ ٱلْعَظْمَ.
verses.kjv: A merry heart doeth good [like] a medicine: but a broken spirit drieth the bones.
verses.web: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

verses.ar: ٱلشِّرِّيرُ يَأْخُذُ ٱلرَّشْوَةَ مِنَ ٱلْحِضْنِ لِيُعَوِّجَ طُرُقَ ٱلْقَضَاءِ.
verses.kjv: A wicked [man] taketh a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
verses.web: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

verses.ar: ٱلْحِكْمَةُ عِنْدَ ٱلْفَهِيمِ، وَعَيْنَا ٱلْجَاهِلِ فِي أَقْصَى ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.kjv: Wisdom [is] before him that hath understanding; but the eyes of a fool [are] in the ends of the earth.
verses.web: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

verses.ar: ٱلِٱبْنُ ٱلْجَاهِلُ غَمٌّ لِأَبِيهِ، وَمَرَارَةٌ لِلَّتِي وَلَدَتْهُ.
verses.kjv: A foolish son [is] a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
verses.web: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

verses.ar: أَيْضًا تَغْرِيمُ ٱلْبَرِيءِ لَيْسَ بِحَسَنٍ، وَكَذَلِكَ ضَرْبُ ٱلشُّرَفَاءِ لِأَجْلِ ٱلِٱسْتِقَامَةِ.
verses.kjv: Also to punish the just [is] not good, [nor] to strike princes for equity.
verses.web: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.

verses.ar: ذُو ٱلْمَعْرِفَةِ يُبْقِي كَلَامَهُ، وَذُو ٱلْفَهْمِ وَقُورُ ٱلرُّوحِ.
verses.kjv: He that hath knowledge spareth his words: [and] a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
verses.web: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلْأَحْمَقُ إِذَا سَكَتَ يُحْسَبُ حَكِيمًا، وَمَنْ ضَمَّ شَفَتَيْهِ فَهِيمًا.
verses.kjv: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: [and] he that shutteth his lips [is esteemed] a man of understanding.
verses.web: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
